angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 1,516,626 km at 418.60 pc = 0.05 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 2.3889 +/- 0.0252 mas (same row, RUWE 1.62): 418.60 pc, no zero-point correction; the RUWE is high, so the astrometry fits a single star poorly, and the parallax is used as published
radiusSource: Radius 2.18 +/- 0.29 solar radii from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-72 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract): 1,516,626 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 2.78 +/- 1.28 solar masses from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of WASP-72 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6250 +/- 100 K from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-72 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-72 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/wasp-72.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.205, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-72 (pscomppars): spectral type F7, from Gillon et al. 2013 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2013A%26A...552A..82G/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-72 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.06 dex, from Stassun et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-72 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.724, from Kokori et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJS..265....4K/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-72 (pscomppars): age 3.2 Gyr, from Bonomo et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-72 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 6 km/s, from Kokori et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJS..265....4K/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
